test_accounting: Final qualification uses the clean committed source revision. No executed tests were ignored. Development runs, three CLI reproductions, and publication-ledger checks are excluded from executed_tests. Native-only tests are absent from the WASM configuration.
source_hash_format: SHA-256 of committed Git blob bytes
implementation: Cursor checkpoints replace per-field token-vector copies and retain numeric operand caches/missing dependencies. Constraint-path lookup immediately rejects absent endpoints, avoiding quadratic graph searches for new startup targets.

Analysis and startup plans share CardBinding and LexicalScopes. Deferred startup cards preserve resolved authored values, functions and builtins, then bind after declaration/source/model completion and before deferred analyses. Failed statistical probes use isolated streams; retries retain completed operands.

Ready and pending startup cards publish in authored order only after successful validation. Scoped voltage expressions retain instance-only parameters; queued scoped records update both the definition registry and nested copies. INITCOND retains lexical value ownership, inline/file grammar and duplicate precedence.

Earlier pending startup failures are validated on isolated contexts before selecting later ordinary errors, including unfinished scopes and physical includes. Existing earlier provisional errors, resource refusals and cancellation retain priority. Temperature recovery still requires fresh-source confirmation.
acceptance_evidence: Twelve portable forward-startup tests exercise IC/device-IC first transient samples, NODESET release to an independent resistor-divider solution, literal/bare/signed operands, derived/global/parent references, captured values/functions, exact samples, source order, instance-only/nested overrides, queued registry copies, duplicate precedence, invalid overwritten cards, mixed errors, include continuations, selected temperatures and every observed cancellation boundary.
Existing temperature-discovery and physical-override unit tests, startup/differential integration, checkpoint, analysis-transaction/origin, declaration/source, resource and CLI tests remain active.

startup_card_allocations.rs counts gross allocation requests only during parsing for 64 and 256 entries, covering root/scoped IC/NODESET. It admits capacity rounding with a 6x growth ceiling; it does not measure peak memory or elapsed time.

allocation_measurements.baseline_note: Baseline source plus the new allocation regression before the fix; fixture was untracked at that point.
allocation_measurements.metric: Sum of requested allocation/reallocation bytes on the parsing thread, excluding deck construction and assertions
